evidence.supports: for every fuel, m, n with m <= fuel, landAux fuel m n = land m n

evidence.notes: Applies the theorem symbolically (against a free `Le m fuel` hypothesis) and at the concrete instance `(fuel, m, n) = (7, 1, 7)`, where `fuel` STRICTLY EXCEEDS the canonical `m`; both `landAux 7 1 7` and `land 1 7` reduce to `1`. The mandatory negative control checks, BY EVALUATION alone (not through this theorem, since `Le 7 1` has no proof), that at INSUFFICIENT fuel the two sides genuinely disagree: `landAux 1 7 7 = 1` while `land 7 7 = 7` -- the same `(1, 7, 7)` witness the `rec_agreement` lane pinned for `bitwise_aux_eq_land_aux`. Without this the theorem's `Le m fuel` hypothesis could be vacuously true of a stronger, unconditional (and false) statement.
evidence.supports: the hypothesis Le m fuel is load-bearing, and the theorem is exactly this, not a weaker or vacuous restatement

formal.statement: ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : AxNat.le x1 x0) -> Eq.{1} AxNat (AxNat.landAux x0 x1 x2) (AxNat.land x1 x2)))))

notes:
formal.statement is `Kernel::render_lean` of the admitted type, taken verbatim from `nat_theorem_inventory`, not transcribed by hand. `AxNat` is the kernel's CONSTRUCTED inductive `Nat` (the `Ax` is *axeyum*, not *axiomatized*); `x0`/`x1`/`x2` are `fuel`/`m`/`n`.

This is fuel-irrelevance for `landAux`, the named blocker on the seven open `natural-bitwise` facts `land_comm`/`land_assoc`/`land_bit`/`lor_comm`/`lor_assoc`/`lor_bit`/`ldiff_bit` (`docs/plan/status/233-nat-rec-agreement.md`): unfolding `landAux` at a non-canonical fuel (e.g. `fuel = bit a m`, `land_bit`'s shape) needs to know that ANY sufficient fuel gives the same answer as the canonical `fuel = m`, not just the fuel `Nat.land` itself supplies.

Proved via `Nat.land_aux_agree_of_fuel : forall fuel1 m n fuel2, Le m fuel1 -> Le m fuel2 -> landAux fuel1 m n = landAux fuel2 m n` (TWO independently-chosen sufficient fuels agree, `ops::agree_by_double_fuel_induction`), specialized at `fuel2 := m` via `le_refl` -- `land m n` and `landAux m m n` are the SAME term by definition, so the specialization needs no extra proof step. The two-fuel form is what avoids ever having to unfold `landAux`'s OWN canonical instance (`landAux m m n`) via `m`'s shape, which is the self-reference a fuel-vs-canonical induction runs into (see `rec_agreement.rs`'s module doc). This theorem does NOT itself close any of the seven blocked facts; `docs/plan/status/237-nat-fuel-irrelevance.md` records what transports to `lorAux`/`ldiffAux` unchanged and what does not.
statement: For every fuel, m, n with m <= fuel, unfolding Nat.landAux at that fuel gives the same result as Nat.land m n.
title: landAux fuel-irrelevance: any sufficient fuel agrees with the canonical one
